decision.comment: Data audit stage passes all deterministic checks with no issues. Verification summary: (1) Archive integrity confirmed — MD5 a8b0696529087d5bd730944a56c1 matches verified_archive_md5; SHA256 present. (2) Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official sizes exactly; no subsampling; train_validation_overlap=0. (3) Image shape 28×28×3 RGB is consistent with the standard MedMNIST distribution. (4) 9-class multi-class task confirmed by manifest, label list, and profiling. (5) No duplicate train samples, no blank images, official_data_fraction=1.0, profiled_fraction=1.0. (6) Class imbalance is modest (ratio 1.63); train and val class proportions are nearly identical, indicating no split-level distribution shift. (7) Test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K), appropriately flagged for OOD evaluation. (8) Representation plan uses six built-in augmentation primitives (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) with augmentation_factor=7 (1+6), all of which require no extension approval. Normalization via z-score is well-justified by the channel statistics (means 0.74/0.53/0.71, stds 0.124/0.177/0.124). (9) Both extension proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain pending_review; per policy, pending proposals do not invalidate the built-in primitives already in use. (10) Run manifest records seed=72, deterministic_torch=true, pinned package versions, and platform details. Minor non-functional observations carried from LLM-assisted stages: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (traceability gap, not a functional defect); ingestion comment uses 'multi-label' where the manifest correctly states 'multi-class' (wording only); compact_conv_token_transformer description is truncated (non-blocking, proposal is non-executable). None of these affect data integrity or pipeline correctness. No deterministic findings. Proceed to next stage.
issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); exact model weights are not pinned, creating a traceability gap for full reproducibility of LLM-assisted decisions (non-functional, warning-level).
Ingestion comment labels the task 'multi-label' but the dataset manifest and profiling confirm a single-label multi-class task; wording inconsistency only, no functional impact.
compact_conv_token_transformer proposal description is truncated, leaving the exact transformer layer count implicit; non-blocking since the proposal is marked non-executable and pending review.

Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
